generator.params.joints.why: Chollas and prickly pears grow as chains of joints.

generator.params.joint_radius.why: A joint's radius, or a pad's half width.

traits.note: Britton and Rose's The Cactaceae (vol. 1, 1919, pp. 8 and 24), as their tribe Opuntieae, today's subfamily Opuntioideae: the only cacti whose areoles bear glochids (Maihuenia aside), and joints without ribs, their areoles scattered over them (Grusonia aside).

rules.note: Spec rework E6c: the joints of chollas and prickly pears from their stated form and size.
